scope: European Netherlands components of current state:NLD compared with current bundled Natural Earth lake polygons and CBS 2022 land/inland-water totals.

method.areaMethod: spherical polygon area, R=6371008.8 m; suitable for same-run comparative audit, not cadastral area
method.europeanComponentRule: NLD polygon components with positive longitude and latitude > 40; excludes Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba components
method.waterSubtractionRule: subtract every bundled lake polygon whose bbox intersects European NLD; all vertices of the two matching lakes were verified inside current European NLD

bundledWaterPolygons.name: IJsselmeer
bundledWaterPolygons.note: Single Natural Earth polygon also covers Markermeer; has one interior hole around major dry-land area.

interpretation: The current Pando European NLD polygon is closer to CBS land+inland-water than to dry land, confirming that large inland waters are part of the country polygon semantics.
Subtracting only the current bundled Natural Earth lake polygons leaves about 34,965 km2, roughly 1,339 km2 (3.98%) above CBS dry land.
The bundled lake polygons account for only about 53% of CBS inland-water area by area. Natural Earth lakes are a selective cartographic layer, not a complete Dutch water mask.
A complete BRT/CBS-aligned water mask should make country-minus-water much closer to dry land, but an actual geometric overlay with TOP10NL waterdeel_vlak has not yet been executed.

The remaining ~1.1% base-area deficit relative to CBS land+inland-water is consistent with Natural Earth coastline/generalization and differing boundary/water semantics; it sets an approximate floor on area agreement even with a complete water mask.
